content.intro: This lesson covers Semantic Versioning and Public API Compatibility. It sits in Module 27, Professional Rust Tooling and Team Workflows, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.
content.why_it_matters: Semantic Versioning and Public API Compatibility matters when you work with reproducible project and team workflows. Understanding the rule helps you predict compiler or runtime behavior, document assumptions, and choose a safer implementation when inputs or system conditions change.
